nondegeneracy.verdict: p2 is NOT a function of p1 on this inventory: a degree-5 polynomial leaves a max residual of 0.980 on a feature whose range is [-1, 1], and the radius has sd 0.251 where the frozen2d family has sd 8.3e-17 (it is exactly unit by construction). doc 54 SS3.1's degeneracy -- the one that made the frozen2d version of this experiment a reparameterisation -- does not hold on the raw family, so exp68 is width-as-INFORMATION.

features.instrument_FA_note: doc 54 SS6.2 writes FA as atan2(PC2, PC1) -- the UNNORMALISED components, i.e. the existing exp42 map -- and that is what this runtime uses, asserted above to 4.0e-15 rad. instrument_sb_bounds.features() computes FA as atan2(p2, p1) on its NORMALISED coords, which on the raw family is a different angle (max difference 7.9e-02 rad). The BOUND is unaffected and the two agree exactly at 148/160: the normalisation is a positive-diagonal linear map of the plane, which preserves the cyclic order of the referents, and a d = 3 single-angle bound depends only on that order. diagnostic_sb_bounds.json carries both computations and they match -- raw FA per-twin 163/190 equals frozen2d FA per-twin 163/190 for tertiary, and the non-occupational target reads 148/160 under the raw-family FA (target_selection.table) and 148/160 under the frozen2d FA, which IS the exp42 map (membership_reconstruction). A TRAINED CIRCUIT is not invariant to the rescaling even though the bound is -- the same reasoning doc 54 SS3.2 gives for pinning the PC signs -- so the doc's literal formula governs the runtime.

identity_init_doc62_SS7_4.two_inits_are_different_circuits_doc62_S: THE TWO INITS ARE DIFFERENT CIRCUITS, NOT TWO DRAWS OF ONE CIRCUIT. The uniform arm begins with its full frequency supply live: V_j ~ U[0, 2pi) is a generic SU(2) and all of {0, +-1, ..., +-L} carries non-zero weight. The identity arm begins a distance O(sigma) from a manifold on which THE SUPPLY DOES NOT EXIST -- at exact identity RY(a).RY(b) = RY(a+b) makes the circuit RY(L.theta), whose spectrum is {0, +-L} -- and must train its way off that manifold before any of the intervention's expressivity is available. This is why doc 59 SS2 refused to treat the init as an optimiser variant for D2, why both inits are arms, and why each gets its OWN procedure-matched floor.
identity_init_doc62_SS7_4.no_cross_experiment_init_narrative_doc62: because identity init REMOVES frequency supply at t = 0 while uniform init supplies it, `init_helps` and `init_hurts` on this rung DO NOT MEASURE THE SAME THING they measure on doc 58's and doc 61's rungs, where the init changed only the effective depth at the first update. SS16 FORBIDS the subtraction and SS12.8(e) refuses any cross-experiment init comparison as a criterion.

instrument_parity_assertion.note: the widened instrument returns EXACTLY the committed residual at ks = [1], so it is provably the committed frame and not a second implementation.

fourier_closure_doc62_SS8_2.derived_basis_doc62_SS2_1: each RY(theta) factor contributes frequencies +-1/2, so the entries of U_L(theta) carry frequencies (L - 2m)/2; every gate after the intro is data-independent and the readout is BILINEAR in amplitude and conjugate amplitude, so the OUTPUT frequencies are the differences m' - m. p(theta) lives in span{1, cos k.theta, sin k.theta : k = 1..L} -- exactly 2L+1 real terms, 5 at L = 2 and 7 at L = 3. DERIVED, NOT ASSERTED -- this is E4's second defect (doc 46 SS17.2) repaired.
fourier_closure_doc62_SS8_2.sign_flip_note_doc62_SS2_1: exp69's `check_closures` failure message already names this experiment: 'the arm is not a single RY, or a referent angle has been RE-UPLOADED inside an event block'. EXP75 IS THE ARM THAT ASSERTION WAS WRITTEN TO DETECT, so exp75 runs it WITH ITS SIGN FLIPPED (C2) and requires the L = 1 anchors to pass it unchanged in the same test run.
fourier_closure_doc62_SS8_2.identity_asymmetry_doc62_SS8_2_1: FOR THE IDENTITY CELLS C1, C2 AND C4 ARE BLOCKING; C3 AND C5 ARE MEASURED AND REPORTED, NOT GATED. By SS3.3 their k = 1..L-1 energy at t = 0 is O(sigma), so a fixed threshold there would encode the NOISE SCALE rather than a property of the build. Stated in advance so the asymmetry is a DECISION and not an omission.

word_order.archived_source: archive/01_parser_pipeline/arabic_dep_reader.py:130-138 (the two verb boxes), :167-180 (_vso and its Swap)
word_order.verdict: SS7.3 DISCHARGED as DERIVATION-DIFFERS / DENOTATION-EQUAL, and the reconciliation is stated rather than buried. The compiled derivations differ -- the VSO reduction carries `Swap(N.l, N)` and the SVO reduction does not -- so the compiler genuinely consults the surface, which is the null-instrument failure SS7.3 exists to catch. The DENOTATIONS are equal (max diff 0.0e+00), which is not a defect but doc 55 SS16.1-Q2's USER-CONFIRMED premise that the two orders are truth-conditionally identical, and which is REQUIRED by SS4.7 ('the same six blocks, reused'), by SS5's 12/72 conditioning-group arithmetic (no surface-order factor) and by SS6.1 (A0 must reproduce exp68 bit-exactly on a dataset that already contains both orders). The Swap is LOAD-BEARING and that is measured, not argued: dropping it moves the state by 1.136 and yields EXACTLY the role-reversed circuit (diff 0.0e+00) -- without the Swap, the VSO clause would say the object did it. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE CLAIM, carried: the circuit is invariant to the alternation by construction, so doc 55 SS6.9's per-surface-order accuracy is a DATA-COMPOSITION statistic and is not evidence about word-order processing. ORCHESTRATOR REVIEW ITEM.

engagement_level1_doc62_SS9_2.M2_bar_is_deliberately_loose: at 10 epochs M2 certifies only that the optimiser TOUCHES the blocks at all. THE DEMANDING BAR IS LEVEL 2 (SS9.3): reupload_engaged(cell, seed) = max_j max |theta_V(selected) - theta_V(init)| >= 0.10 rad, measured on EVERY trained checkpoint.
engagement_level1_doc62_SS9_2.threshold_provenance_doc62_SS9_3: E4's kappa moved by MAX +0.0780 across all 34 S-reup runs (mean +0.0064, min -0.0201), so a 0.10 rad bar would have failed EVERY ONE of them, INCLUDING THE MOST-MOVED. exp57's `M-wide-ROT` moved by 5.94e-05 rad, three orders below. The bar is ABSOLUTE, PER RUN, on the maximum over the block's 6 or 12 parameters, and IS NOT A MEAN OVER SEEDS -- E4's arm passed on its mean only because 34 runs were averaged into a summary. Orchestrator ruling 3 ACCEPTS it as calibrated.
engagement_level1_doc62_SS9_2.what_SS9_is_not_doc62_SS9_5: SS9 is NOT a criterion about whether the trained model USES its harmonics -- that is SS11.3's descriptive, it has no boolean, and it MAY NOT BE PROMOTED. A model whose blocks moved 1.2 rad and whose trained output is nonetheless effectively single-harmonic is ADMISSIBLE AND INFORMATIVE; a model whose blocks never moved is INADMISSIBLE AND UNINFORMATIVE. The distinction is the whole content of E4's erratum.
